title: China Is Selling Brand-New Cars as "Used". Here's Why #shorts

scenes.text: Zero miles. No owner. And in China, this car is sold as used.
Dealers register brand-new cars, then cancel the plates. On paper, sold. Now it's used.
Blame a price war that's lasted years. Too many cars, so these sell for up to twenty to thirty percent off.
China exported about four hundred thirty-six thousand used cars in twenty twenty-four. Analysts think most had zero miles.
But buyers lose warranty time, dealers abroad get undercut, and sales look bigger than they are.
Since January, cars under a hundred eighty days old need the maker's approval to export as used.
Smart bargain, or fake sales? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
